remark:
1. Total land area of the project as per Reconstitution letter and site plan issued by JDA is 34351.88 sqm whereas on-ground available area as mentioned in approved site plan and approval letter issued by JDA, is 33607.37 sqm therefore, total land area is considered as 33607.37 sqm. while registering project with RERA. 
2. Promoter represents that Phase Area for the Project under registration is 4136.90 sq. mt., however, the same has been inadvertently mentioned above as 6663.90 sq. mt. Therefore, the Phase Area for the Project should be read as 4136.90 sq. mt. in place of 6663.90 sq. mt. 
3. Promoter proposes to develop a group housing project comprising of S+14(44.975 mtr. height) and submitted drawings before JDA for approval. Approval of buildings with height more than 40 mtr. is done by JDA only after State Govt. approval. JDA approved and released building plan upto 40 mt. of height i.e. S+12 vide letter dated 28.11.19 and forwarded the proposal of height beyond 40 mt. i.e. S+14 for State Govt.'s approval. Promoter will presently commence booking of units only upto S+12 and booking of units above S+12 shall commence post approval of height above 40 mt. from State Govt. and release of building plan above 40 mt. Promoter represents that if in future, State Govt does not grant approval of S+14 or grants lesser height than 44.975, then the Project shall have buildings of S+12 or S+13, as the case may be. Further, Promoter reserves its rights to restrict the height of the building upto S+12 or S+13, as per its discretion. Under such circumstances, allottee of 12th or 13th floor as the case may be shall be the allottee of the top floor and shall not object to this. Allottee acknowledges this fact and is booking the unit in the project with the aforesaid knowledge and has no objection to it. We shall inform the RERA Authority accordingly. 4.We have scanned the approved building plans to the best of our ability and according to hard copies of plans available with us.As per remark the correct phase area has been rectified in Land Details of Registering Project.

costDetail.n: For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub-section (2) of section 4, the land cost shall be the cost incurred by the promoter whether as an outright purchase, lease charges etc.
Revenue or area share given to land owner in lieu of land under any kind of agreement such as Joint Venture, Joint Development etc, in case the Promoter is not the owner of the land.
Amount paid to land owner. (Method of land valuation)
Incidental costs related to acquisition of land such as stamp duty, brokerage, settlement costs of litigation, premiums paid to government authorities related to land.
Interest on finance for purchase of land.
Litigation costs incurred for land acquisition.
Property and other taxes, fees, premiums paid.
Estimated Cost of Construction as certified by Engineer

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e. 
salaries, consultants fees, site overheads, cost of services (including water, electricity, sewerage), cost of 
machineries and equipment including its hire and maintenance costs, consumables etc. All costs directly 
incurred to complete the construction of the buildings /wings of the project registered
Payment of Taxes, cess, fees, charges, Approval cost for Construction etc. premiums, interest etc. to any statutory Authority
Interest payable to financial institutions, scheduled banks, non-banking financial institution (NBFC) or money lenders on construction funding or money borrowed for construction & Project
